$comment: Supported boards, in display order. The website's board cards and supported-boards list, the installer's board menu and the site build's firmware list come from here. Adding a board: docs/contributing/adding-a-board.md.

boards.summary: The simplest, cheapest place to start, with a built-in screen.

boards.name: Heltec Wireless Stick V3
boards.summary: The smallest board, for compact kits and cases, with a glanceable status screen.

boards.name: LILYGO T-Beam V1.2

boards.name: Seeed SenseCAP T1000-E
